#include <stack>
#include <queue>
#include <iostream>
#include <cstdio>
using namespace std;

int n, t, counter, source_cap[10][10], sink_cap[10][10], source_num[10][10], sink_num[10][10], plant[10][10][61], flo[200][200];
int dr[] = {0, 0, -1, 1}, dc[] = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

bool is_valid(int r, int c) {
    return r >= 0 && r < n && c >= 0 && c < n;
}

int get_path() {
    vector<int> parent(counter + 1, -1);
    parent[0] = 0;
    stack<int> dfs;
    dfs.push(0);
    while (!dfs.empty()) {
        int top = dfs.top();
        dfs.pop();
        if (top == counter) break;
        for (int i = 0; i <= counter; ++i) {
            if (flo[top][i] && parent[i] == -1) {
                parent[i] = top;
                dfs.push(i);
            }
        }
    }
    if (parent[counter] == -1) return 0;
    int ans = 10000, pos = counter;
    while (pos != 0) {
        ans = min(ans, flo[parent[pos]][pos]);
        pos = parent[pos];
    }
    pos = counter;
    while (pos != 0) {
        flo[parent[pos]][pos] -= ans;
        flo[pos][parent[pos]] += ans;
        pos = parent[pos];
    }
    return ans;
}

    scanf("%d %d", &n, &t);
    char inp[n][n + 1];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) scanf("%s", inp[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {

                source_cap[i][j] = inp[i][j] - '0';

        }

                plant[i][j][0] = inp[i][j] - 'X';
                sink_cap[i][j] = 0;
            } else {
                plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                sink_cap[i][j] = inp[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
    }
    for (int curr_time = 1; curr_time <= t; ++curr_time) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                plant[i][j][curr_time] = plant[i][j][curr_time - 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (plant[i][j][curr_time - 1] == 2)

            if (source_cap[i][j] != 0) {
                source_num[i][j] = counter++;

                source_num[i][j] = -1;

            if (sink_cap[i][j] != 0) {
                sink_num[i][j] = counter++;

                sink_num[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
    }

            if (source_cap[i][j] == 0) continue;
            bfs.push({0, {i, j}});
            vector<vector<bool>> vis(n, vector<bool>(n, false));
            vis[i][j] = true;

                int curr_time = top.first, r = top.second.first, c = top.second.second;
                if (sink_cap[r][c] != 0)
                    flo[source_num[i][j]][sink_num[r][c]] = 10000;
                if (curr_time == t) continue;
                if (plant[r][c][curr_time] != 0) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                    if (is_valid(nr, nc) && plant[nr][nc][curr_time] == 0 && !vis[nr][nc]) {
                        bfs.push({curr_time + 1, {nr, nc}});
                        vis[nr][nc] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

                flo[sink_num[i][j]][counter] = sink_cap[i][j];

        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) scanf("%s", inp[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (inp[i][j] == 'Y' || inp[i][j] == 'Z') {
                plant[i][j][0] = inp[i][j] - 'X';
                sink_cap[i][j] = 0;
            } else {
                plant[i][j][0] = 0;
                sink_cap[i][j] = inp[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
    }
    for (int curr_time = 1; curr_time <= t; ++curr_time) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                plant[i][j][curr_time] = plant[i][j][curr_time - 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
                if (plant[i][j][curr_time - 1] == 2)
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int ni = i + dr[k], nj = j + dc[k];
                        if (is_valid(ni, nj) && plant[ni][nj][curr_time - 1] == 0)
                            plant[ni][nj][curr_time] = 2;
                    }
    }
    int node_id = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (source_cap[i][j] != 0) source_num[i][j] = node_id++;
            else source_num[i][j] = -1;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (sink_cap[i][j] != 0) sink_num[i][j] = node_id++;
            else sink_num[i][j] = -1;
        }
    }
    queue<pair<int, pair<int, int>>> q;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (source_cap[i][j] == 0) continue;
            q.push({0, {i, j}});
            vector<vector<bool>> vis(n, vector<bool>(n, false));
            vis[i][j] = true;
            while (!q.empty()) {
                auto top = q.front(); q.pop();
                int curr_time = top.first, r = top.second.first, c = top.second.second;
                if (sink_cap[r][c] != 0)
                    flo[source_num[i][j]][sink_num[r][c]] = 10000;
                if (curr_time == t) continue;
                if (plant[r][c][curr_time] != 0) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = r + dr[k], nc = c + dc[k];
                    if (is_valid(nr, nc) && plant[nr][nc][curr_time] == 0 && !vis[nr][nc]) {
                        q.push({curr_time + 1, {nr, nc}});
                        vis[nr][nc] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (source_cap[i][j] != 0)
                flo[0][source_num[i][j]] = source_cap[i][j];
            if (sink_cap[i][j] != 0)
                flo[sink_num[i][j]][node_id] = sink_cap[i][j];
        }
    }
    int total_flow = 0, flow;
    while ((flow = get_path()) != 0) total_flow += flow;
    cout << total_flow;
    return 0;
